sloka: भरतम् मुर्च्Cइतम् द्रुष्ट्वा विवर्णवदनो गुहः ।बभूव व्यथितस्तत्र भूमिकम्पे यथा द्रुमः ॥२-८७-४॥
transliteration: bharatam murcCitam druṣṭvā vivarṇavadano guhaḥ ।babhūva vyathitastatra bhūmikampe yathā drumaḥ ॥2-87-4॥

translations.english: Seeing Bharata in that state, Satrughna who was standing close by, smitten with grief clasped him, cried loudly and fell senseless.
